dedupe_keys.name: machine learning based settlement models for shallow founded structures on interbedded liquefiable sites considering dense granular columns

description: Machine Learning-Based Settlement Models for Shallow-Founded Structures on Interbedded Liquefiable Sites Considering Dense Granular Columns is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Caroline Bessette, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). This project develops machine learning (ML)-based predictive models for estimating the permanent settlement of foundations on stratigraphically variable liquefiable deposits, considering both unmitigated conditions and those mitigated using Dense Granular Columns (DGCs). The dataset consists of approximately 4,000 fully-coupled, nonlinear finite element analyses performed in the object-oriented, open-source FE computational OpenSees platform. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 7 top-level files (CSV, PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-bjqe-k676. Keywords: Liquefaction,  Machine-Learning, Soil-Structure Interaction, Mitigation,  Dense Granular Columns, Stratigraphic Variability. Published 2025-03-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
